suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO Event Loop Deep Dive
suggestion.rationale: Developers frequently struggle with asynchronous programming mental models, searching for how the single-threaded event loop actually schedules coroutines without blocking. Addressing this clears massive friction points and drives high watch-time completion.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop writing async/await code like normal functions; if you don't understand the event loop tick, your I/O bound tasks are secretly running synchronously.
